content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any documents relevant to safety/maintenance or absorber activation. Extract the three allowed absorber materials, any hands-on maintenance restrictions, and the permitted plate-thickness range."},{"id":"s2","description":"Exclude any candidate absorber material that violates the hands-on maintenance requirement according to the project documents. Record which material indices remain eligible using numeric codes for later reference."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each eligible material, run simulate_resolution at representative plate thicknesses spanning 2–10 mm, e.g. 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record every numeric resolution result with its material code and thickness."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best-performing material and approximate thickness region from the coarse scan. For that material, run a finer scan around the best coarse thickness using 1 mm or smaller spacing within 2–10 mm, and record all numeric resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all recorded simulation results and determine the eligible absorber material and plate thickness with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution. Record the final best material code, thickness, and resolution numerically for the reporting module."}]}
